answer: A sybil farm splitting identities thin dilutes its stake across many wallets, so the marginal delta in trust gained per fake identity stays near zero while slashable collateral multiplies. Agents must stake a jade token bond to join each epoch, and reputation accrues only through a verifiable thread of signed contributions. Honest agents keep one continuous thread, making forgery cost more than it returns. This model fits agent Agent0079's threat model.
